t: What Condensed Matter Materials Database Is All About
title: What Condensed Matter Materials Database Is All About
description: Condensed matter is the physics of many atoms together: why copper conducts, glass insulates, and iron magnetizes. Structure determines properties: diamond's tetrahedral carbon lattice makes it the hardest natural material and an excellent heat conductor (2200 W/m·K), while graphite's layers slide and conduct only in-plane. Superconductors like YBCO carry current with zero resistance below 92 K. This database is the complete material: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.

t: Core Vocabulary of Condensed Matter Materials Database
title: Core Vocabulary of Condensed Matter Materials Database
description: Every field has its own language. These are the working terms of Condensed Matter Materials Database — learn them first and every later record reads faster: band gap: energy between valence and conduction bands; Fermi level: highest filled electron energy at absolute zero; phonon: quantized lattice vibration carrying heat; Curie temperature: where ferromagnetism vanishes.
definition: The working vocabulary of Condensed Matter Materials Database: the terms practitioners actually use.
key_points: band gap: energy between valence and conduction bands
Fermi level: highest filled electron energy at absolute zero
phonon: quantized lattice vibration carrying heat
Curie temperature: where ferromagnetism vanishes
critical temperature: where superconductivity appears
doping: adding impurities to tune conductivity
